services.name: Day or Night Flight to Downtown Atlanta in Piper Cherokee
services.desc: Come join us for a night flight over Atlanta in a Piper Cherokee! services.name: Shoot The Hooch
services.desc: See Atlanta like never before! Duration 24-28 Minutes About The "City of Trees" is best experienced from an open-cockpit biplane during the Fall season. Let us take you on a special route over the Chattahoochee River to see the leaves changing color. Enjoy the crisp, cool air (from a true-to-life vintage WWII cadet trainer) that gets us all excited about pumpkin spice season. This first prominent landmark will be the King & Queen building, and from there your pilot will proceed north along the GA400 until it crosses the Chattahoochee. Joining the river from there, we will proceed westbound-then southwest-bound, following the river from OTP (Outside The Perimeter for all you non-Atlantans)

services.name: Historic Stone Mountain
services.desc: Fly 6 minutes east of Atlanta to the city of Stone Mountain, where the vast monolith awaits at the gateway to Stone Mountain Park. Rates Up to 2 People: $169 per person About See the Confederate Memorial Carving, etched into the rock’s side, which depicts Civil War generals Stonewall Jackson and Robert E. Lee, plus President Jefferson Davis. See the tiny little ant people below on the trail and the Summit Skyride cable car, both of which lead to the rock's peak. Spot the historic buildings dating back to 1793 which fill the park's Historic Square. There is no better way to experience Stone Mountain than from our open-cockpit biplane 1,000 feet
